settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: AI providers and models, prompts, voice and backup
settings.offlineDesc: Articles, vocabulary and progress are stored in this browser (IndexedDB). Export a backup now and then, especially before clearing site data or switching devices. Backups do not include your API key.
settings.exportSuccess: Data exported successfully to local JSON file!
settings.testSuccess: Success! Model connection verified and TTS audio received.
settings.savedNotice: Settings saved to local storage and active immediately
settings.keyPrivacy: The key is stored only in this browser and sent only to {{provider}} when you use an AI feature. There is no app server.
settings.needsKeyNotice: Add your API key to use word and sentence analysis, audio and pronunciation feedback.
settings.storageNotProtected: Browser may clear this data if it runs low on space or you stay away for a while
settings.cacheSummary: Saved answers: {{words}} words, {{sentences}} sentences, {{drills}} drill sets
settings.cacheDesc: Explanations and drills are saved on this device so you never pay for the same answer twice. Words are kept until you clear them, sentences and drills for 30 days. They are not part of backups.
settings.audioSummary: Pronunciation audio: {{clips}} clips, {{mb}} MB; {{kept}} kept for your vocabulary
settings.audioDesc: Every clip is saved so it plays offline and is never generated twice. Audio for words in your vocabulary, their sentences and examples is always kept; the rest is trimmed when it grows past 200 MB.
settings.backupAudio: Include pronunciation audio for my vocabulary (larger file)
settings.importAudioPartial: Backup restored, but {{failed}} audio clips could not be saved on this device (storage may be full). Playing those words will generate them again.
settings.textSectionDesc: Writes word and sentence analyses, practice drills and pronunciation feedback.
settings.speechSectionDesc: Reads French aloud. It can be a different provider from the one above.
settings.sameKeyNote: Uses the same {{provider}} key as above.
settings.promptsDesc: The instructions sent to the AI, as plain text. Edit them to change how answers are written; reset any prompt to go back to the original. Answers already saved on this device stay as they are; edited prompts get fresh answers.
settings.promptSyntax: Write {{open}}name{{close}} for a variable and {{open}}#if name{{close}}…{{open}}/if{{close}} for text that appears only when it has a value; {{open}}#if name=value{{close}} compares it to a value.

pwa.chromeDesc: Click the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install Relire.

pwa.noServerDesc: Your articles, vocabulary and settings are stored in this browser. Reading and vocabulary review work offline. Word and sentence analysis, audio and pronunciation feedback need a connection and your Gemini key.

onboarding.label: Getting started
onboarding.welcomeBody: Open an article, tap any word or sentence to see what it means in context, then read it aloud and get feedback on your pronunciation.
onboarding.welcomeNeed: The explanations come from an AI service ({{provider}} by default). You need a free API key; it stays in this browser and is only sent to that service.
onboarding.tryTitle: Try it on a sample article
onboarding.tipWord: Tap a word to see its meaning in context, how to pronounce it, and how the verb is conjugated.
onboarding.tipSentence: Tap a sentence, then Analyze, to see its structure and grammar and to practise reading it aloud.
onboarding.tipSpeak: Save words you want to remember; they come back for review on a schedule.

keyBanner.text: Add your API key to turn on word and sentence analysis, audio and pronunciation feedback.
